stage1_over_capacity.finding: Requests beyond the 32-slot cache capacity remain correct through caller-owned uncached table construction.

stage2_amortization.finding: Normal below-capacity exact-key reuse preserves one build per unique key and repeated cache hits.

semantics: Cache capacity is an optimization bound, not a correctness bound.
No cache-size increase or eviction policy is introduced.
No hydraulic representation, error gate or dry-tail policy is changed.
On full-cache miss the requested immutable representation is built and returned but not inserted.
